answer.reason: The verses only record her marriage to Esau and her family ties, which the summary already gives, and the marked verses in Genesis 36 concern Bashemath, whose name differs.
doubts: GEN 36:3, 36:4, 36:10, 36:13 and 36:17 name Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter and sister of Nebajoth, who may be the same woman under another name, but the verses do not say so, so they were left out.
